name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires either employment with a specific employer (Form 1) or authorisation to engage in self-employment (Form 2).
requirements.fix_path: Secure employment or establish a qualifying self-employed occupation.

requirements.blocker_text: Applications are made through the Prime Minister's Office rather than as an extension of visitor status.

sources.title: High Commission for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, UK -- Non-National: work permits via Form 1 (employed by a specific employer) or Form 2 (self-employed), medical elective students at Milton Cato Memorial Hospital exempt with a hospital acceptance letter
Prime Minister's Office, Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines -- Citizenship (and related permit) page: Work Permit application fee EC$150, maximum validity 6 months

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' initial build. NOTABLY SHORT maximum validity (6 months) compared to every other work permit built this session (most Caribbean/BOT equivalents run 1 year) -- confirmed on the official pmoffice.gov.vc fee page, not an assumption. No labour-market-test (job advertisement) requirement was found on any tier-1 source for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, unlike Grenada's, Trinidad and Tobago's, or the BOTs' work permit regimes -- this may reflect a genuinely lighter-touch process, or simply a gap in the sources reviewed (the official 'Residence Work Permit and Citizenship Requirements' PDF exists but could not be read -- it appears to be an image-only scan with no extractable text). pr_after_months left null since no specific work-permit-to-residence timeline was found; switchable_to reflects the general possibility of applying for residence, not a guaranteed or timed conversion.
